'''Star Tours Flight 426''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and scheduled to depart at 1415 hours from Gate 1A.
